t: This is Maida Vale, a residential district of north-west London. Two people connected to it are worth a mention. Joanna Mary Boyce was born here in 1831. She became a painter associated with the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, producing historical subjects, portraits and sketches, and writing art criticism that responded to her contemporaries. Her brother George Price Boyce was also a Pre-Raphaelite watercolourist. M. W. Hallett, a London gentleman and theatrical amateur, died here in 1882.
